## 2. Core Production Systems & Flagship Proof
1. **INKICA AI Studio (`https://ai.inkica.com/`)**:
   - AI Prepress platform for Print-on-Demand: 300 DPI Graphic Extraction combining **SAM 3 + DIS5K + ViTMatte**.
   - AOP 3D Pattern Studio covering **208 SKUs / 88 Canonical Garment Models** with CAD Cubic Bezier packing (**0 px overlap**), `.PSD` multi-layer, `.DST` embroidery, Halftone LPI & **Three.js WebGL** real-time 3D multi-color mockup.
   - Tech stack: Next.js, Three.js WebGL, NestJS, PostgreSQL, BullMQ GPU Workers.
2. **DOMATION ERP 5.0 & Chia Data Đa Đại Lý (< 4s) (`https://domation.net/`)**:
   - **12 integrated modules**: GPS Mobile Check-in (Geofencing), Shift Scheduling, Leave Approval, Payroll Engine, CRM Pipeline, Task Kanban, Workchat Realtime, Asset Management, KPI Scoring.
   - **Meta CAPI & Chia Data Pipeline**: Weighted Round-Robin routing to multiple F1 agencies in `< 3.8s`, ZaloBot 1-tap SLA claim + Auto-Reclaim at 120s, SHA-256 hashed server-side CAPI restoring **+34% conversion attribution** (EMQ **9.2/10**).
3. **EcoLife Signature Đà Nẵng — Capital House (`https://ai.ecolifesignature.vn/`)**:
   - Interactive 3D WebGL floorplan & balcony explorer + AI Sales Portal for 200+ agency reps + 25 Offline/OOH deliverables synchronized via UTM & Chia Data pipeline (**2.4x time on site: 4m 18s**, **74% qualified lead rate**).
4. **Zalo Mini App + Zalo OA ZNS (IDEAS / Loyalty)**:
   - ReactJS + ZaUI + ZMP SDK zero-install mobile app: **88%+ 1-tap phone verification**, **82% ZNS read rate** (4x email), **56% 90-day cohort retention**.
